description: Shared Renovate base preset for roleme repos. Edit here to change behavior everywhere. Repos reference it via extends: github>roleme/workflows//renovate-presets/default.json

packageRules.description: Major dependency updates commit as feat(deps) so release-please cuts a MINOR release of this shared repo. A dependency's own major is a fact about THAT dependency's interface, not ours - our consumers call our reusable workflows, whose inputs/outputs are unchanged by it. A minor keeps the signal that something notable moved without inflating our major. Non-major updates inherit semanticCommitType=fix -> patch. MAJOR is reserved for breaking changes to OUR OWN interface, authored by hand as feat!: / fix!: - see docs/versioning.md.

Default for ALL managers (npm, pip, docker, github-actions): automerge patch+minor once the PR's CI is green. platformAutomerge=false means Renovate itself merges on a later run after it detects green checks, and ignoreTests=false keeps that gated on green. Consumer repos vary in whether they have required status checks, so Renovate-side automerge is the portable gate rather than relying on platform automerge honouring branch protection. The 10-day minimumReleaseAge soak above still applies before any merge. Majors fall through to the rule below and stay manual; per-repo renovate.json rules (DBs, React major, etc.) are evaluated after this and override it.

Our own shared reusables (roleme/workflows) — no soak, auto-merge non-major on green. We control this repo and it is released via release-please (patch/minor verified by its own CI before the tag is cut), so consumers should pick up new versions immediately and let their own required checks be the gate. Major bumps fall through to the rule below and stay manual.
roleme/workflows major bumps — never automerge (breaking change in shared CI). Pin to the new vN by hand after reviewing the changelog.

Self-reference: inside roleme/workflows itself, same-repo action pins (e.g. komodo-deploy) point at commits already merged and CI-verified in this repo. The vN tag is cut by our own release-please, so a 'major' here is not an unreviewed upstream breaking change - it is our own already-reviewed code. No soak, automerge every update type including major. matchRepositories scopes this to this repo only, so consumers keep the manual-major gate above.
